priorityList: Maintain Lightning Shield, Flametongue Weapon, and Thunderstrike Ward at all times.
Cast Stormkeeper if Ascendance has more than 10 seconds remaining on its cooldown or is ready to use.
Cast Ancestral Swiftness on cooldown to summon Ancestors.
Cast Ascendance if Stormkeeper has more than 15 seconds remaining on its cooldown.
Use offensive Trinkets, Potions, and Racial abilities during Ascendance.
Cast Flame Shock if it is missing or refreshable, but only if the Master of the Elements buff is not active.
Cast Voltaic Blaze if the Master of the Elements buff is not active and Flame Shock needs refreshing.
Cast Lava Burst (prioritizing Lava Surge procs) if Master of the Elements is not active and you will not overcap Maelstrom.
Cast Lightning Bolt while Stormkeeper is active, ideally to consume a Master of the Elements buff.
Cast Elemental Blast to spend Maelstrom.
Cast Earth Shock to spend Maelstrom if Elemental Blast is not known or available.
Use Lightning Bolt as your primary filler spell.
Use Flame Shock, Voltaic Blaze, or Frost Shock if you are forced to move and cannot cast fillers.
